title: Rav Huna son of Moshe bar Atzri HaKohen
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Batra 174b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.174b.9-11): his father Moshe bar Atzri was guarantor for his daughter-in-law’s ketubah. Rav Huna his son was a Torah scholar and was in hard straits. Abaye said: “Is there no one to advise Rav Huna to divorce his wife, so that she will claim her ketubah from his father?” In the end it emerged that he was a Kohen. Abaye said: “This is what people say: poverty follows the poor.”[^1]

notes.text: [Heilprin’s entry for Moshe bar Atzri](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2561&lang=en) also gives him as Rav Huna the Kohen’s father. The linked Bavli gives the discussion about the guarantee and then reveals Rav Huna’s priestly status.
